```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4, dpi = 150)
library(expoquimR)
library(ggplot2)
if (!is.null(params$lang) && nzchar(params$lang)) expoquimr_lang(params$lang)

L <- function(en, es) if (identical(params$lang, "es")) es else en

# Presentation-only translations: stable column identifiers remain unchanged.
column_labels <- c(
  substance = "Sustancia", phrases = "Frases H/R", grade = "Grupo de peligro",
  volatility = "Volatilidad/pulverulencia", quantity = "Cantidad",
  risk = "Nivel de riesgo", measures = "Medidas de control",
  product = "Producto", hazard_class = "Clase de peligro",
  quantity_class = "Clase de cantidad", frequency_class = "Clase de frecuencia",
  potential_exposure_class = "Exposición potencial",
  potential_risk_class = "Riesgo potencial",
  potential_risk_score = "Puntuación de riesgo potencial",
  volatility_dustiness_class = "Volatilidad/pulverulencia",
  volatility_dustiness_score = "Puntuación de volatilidad/pulverulencia",
  procedure_class = "Clase de procedimiento", procedure_score = "Puntuación de procedimiento",
  protection_class = "Protección colectiva", protection_score = "Puntuación de protección",
  vla_correction_factor = "Factor de corrección VLA",
  inhalation_risk = "Riesgo por inhalación",
  risk_characterisation = "Caracterización del riesgo",
  agent = "Agente", mean_ie = "IE medio", combined_ie = "IE combinado",
  group_result = "Resultado del grupo", day = "Jornada",
  concentration = "Concentración", time = "Tiempo (h)", ed = "ED", ie = "IE"
)
localise_table <- function(df) {
  if (identical(params$lang, "es")) {
    hits <- match(names(df), names(column_labels))
    names(df)[!is.na(hits)] <- unname(column_labels[hits[!is.na(hits)]])
  }
  df
}
localise_distribution <- function(value) {
  if (identical(params$lang, "es") && identical(value, "Neither")) return("Ninguna")
  if (identical(params$lang, "en") && identical(value, "Ninguna")) return("Neither")
  value
}

result_box <- function(result) {
  if (identical(params$lang, "es")) {
    result <- switch(result %||% "",
      "CONFORMITY" = "CONFORMIDAD",
      "NON-CONFORMITY" = "NO CONFORMIDAD",
      "NO DECISION" = "SIN DECISIÓN",
      "INSUFFICIENT DATA" = "DATOS INSUFICIENTES",
      result)
  } else {
    result <- switch(result %||% "",
      "CONFORMIDAD" = "CONFORMITY",
      "NO CONFORMIDAD" = "NON-CONFORMITY",
      "NO DECISIÓN" = "NO DECISION",
      "DATOS INSUFICIENTES" = "INSUFFICIENT DATA",
      result)
  }
  css <- switch(result %||% "x",
    "CONFORMITY"     = , "CONFORMIDAD"    = "conform",
    "NON-CONFORMITY" = , "NO CONFORMIDAD" = "no-conform",
    "no-decision"
  )
  sprintf('<div class="result-box %s">%s</div>', css, result %||% L("No data", "Sin datos"))
}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || (length(a) == 1 && is.na(a))) b else a
```

```{r coshh_block, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$coshh)}
cat("## COSHH Essentials\n\n")
cat(L('<div class="method-intro">Qualitative control-banding method (UK HSE). Assigns substances to hazard groups A–E and produces a risk level (1–4) with recommended control measures.</div>\n\n', '<div class="method-intro">Método cualitativo de bandas de control (HSE, Reino Unido). Clasifica las sustancias en grupos de peligro A–E y establece un nivel de riesgo (1–4) con medidas de control recomendadas.</div>\n\n'))

# Reference tables
hg <- data.frame(
  Group = c("A","B","C","D","E"),
  `Hazard level` = c(L("Low", "Bajo"),L("Moderate", "Moderado"),L("Significant", "Significativo"),L("High", "Alto"),L("Very high (CMR)", "Muy alto (CMR)")),
  `Typical H phrases` = c(
    "H303, H315, H319, H336 — or any not listed in B–E (default)",
    "H302, H312, H332, H371",
    "H301, H311, H314, H317, H331, H335",
    "H300, H310, H330, H351, H360, H372",
    "H334, H340, H341, H350, H350i"),
  check.names = FALSE)

cat(knitr::kable(hg, caption = L("Reference — COSHH hazard groups", "Referencia — grupos de peligro COSHH"), align=c("c","l","l")) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","bordered","condensed"),
                            full_width=TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))

rl <- data.frame(
  `Risk level` = 1:4,
  `Typical situation` = c(
    "Low hazard (A/B), small quantity, low volatility/dustiness",
    "Medium hazard or moderate quantity/volatility",
    "High hazard or large quantity — containment needed",
    "CMR substances or very high hazard"),
  `Control approach` = c(
    L("General ventilation", "Ventilación general"),
    L("Local exhaust ventilation", "Extracción localizada"),
    L("Containment or closed systems", "Confinamiento o sistemas cerrados"),
    L("Comply with CMR legislation; detailed exposure assessment", "Cumplir la normativa CMR; evaluación detallada de la exposición")),
  check.names = FALSE)

cat(knitr::kable(rl, caption=L("Reference — COSHH risk levels", "Referencia — niveles de riesgo COSHH"), align=c("c","l","l")) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","bordered","condensed"),
                            full_width=TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))

cat(L("\n### Assessment results\n\n", "\n### Resultados de la evaluación\n\n"))
df <- if (is.data.frame(params$coshh)) params$coshh else as.data.frame(params$coshh)
cat(knitr::kable(localise_table(df), caption=L("COSHH Essentials — Results by substance", "COSHH Essentials — resultados por sustancia"), align="l") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                            full_width=TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))
```

```{r inrs_block, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$inrs)}
cat(L("## INRS Method\n\n", "## Método INRS\n\n"))
cat(L('<div class="method-intro">Qualitative inhalation risk score (INRS France). Score = hazard potential × quantity/frequency × volatility/dustiness × process type × collective protection.</div>\n\n', '<div class="method-intro">Método cualitativo de evaluación del riesgo por inhalación (INRS, Francia). La puntuación combina peligrosidad, cantidad/frecuencia, volatilidad/pulverulencia, procedimiento y protección colectiva.</div>\n\n'))

ih <- data.frame(
  `Hazard class` = 1:5,
  `VLA (mg/m³)` = c("> 100","> 10 – 100","> 1 – 10","> 0.1 – 1","≤ 0.1"),
  Score = c(1,10,100,1000,10000),
  `Typical H phrases` = c(
    "Any not in classes 2–5 (default)",
    "H335, H336","H304, H332, H361, H373",

    "H330, H340, H350, H350i"),

  Action = c(L("No modifications needed a priori", "A priori no se requieren modificaciones"),
```

```{r une689_intro, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$une689)}
cat("## UNE-EN 689\n\n")
cat(L('<div class="method-intro">Quantitative statistical assessment (European standard EN 689). Compares daily exposure (ED) values against the OEL using lognormal or normal distribution fitting and a one-sided tolerance limit LSC(95,70).</div>\n\n', '<div class="method-intro">Evaluación estadística cuantitativa conforme al procedimiento implementado de UNE-EN 689. Compara las exposiciones diarias (ED) con el VLA mediante ajustes normal o log-normal y el límite superior LSC(95,70).</div>\n\n'))

pr <- data.frame(
  Condition=c(L("All IE < 0.1", "Todos los IE < 0,1"),L("Any IE > 1.0", "Algún IE > 1,0"),L("Any IE between 0.1 and 1.0", "Algún IE entre 0,1 y 1,0")),
  Result=c(L("CONFORMITY", "CONFORMIDAD"),L("NON-CONFORMITY", "NO CONFORMIDAD"),L("NO DECISION", "SIN DECISIÓN")),
  `Next step`=c(L("No further action required", "No se requiere evaluación estadística adicional según el criterio preliminar"),L("Immediate corrective action", "Adoptar medidas correctoras"),
                 L("Proceed to statistical assessment (≥ 6 days total)", "Continuar con la evaluación estadística (al menos 6 jornadas)")),
  check.names=FALSE)
cat(knitr::kable(pr, caption=L("Reference — Preliminary assessment decision rules", "Referencia — criterios de decisión preliminar"),
                 align=c("l","l","l")) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","bordered","condensed"),
                            full_width=TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))

sr <- data.frame(
  Condition=c("UR ≥ UT","UR < UT"),
  Result=c(L("CONFORMITY", "CONFORMIDAD"),L("NON-CONFORMITY", "NO CONFORMIDAD")),
  Meaning=c(L("LSC(95,70) is below the OEL with 95% confidence", "El LSC(95,70) es inferior al VLA"),
            L("Insufficient evidence that exposure is below the OEL", "No se acredita la conformidad de la exposición con el VLA")))
cat(knitr::kable(sr, caption=L("Reference — Statistical assessment decision rule", "Referencia — criterio de decisión estadística"),
                 align=c("l","l","l")) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","bordered","condensed"),
                            full_width=TRUE) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))
```

```{r une689_agents, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$une689)}
if (!is.null(params$une689$preliminary)) {

  # Generate one block per agent using knit_child over in-memory text
  agent_chunks <- lapply(names(params$une689$preliminary), function(agent_name) {
    ag  <- params$une689$preliminary[[agent_name]]
    est <- ag$statistics
    eds <- if (!is.null(est)) est$eds else NULL

    # Build the chunk text dynamically
    lines <- c(
      sprintf('\n<div class="agent-block">'),
      sprintf(L('<div class="agent-title">Agent: %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; OEL = %.4f mg/m³</div>', '<div class="agent-title">Agente: %s &nbsp;|&nbsp; VLA = %.4f mg/m³</div>'),

              ag$name, ag$vla),
      ""
    )

    # Days table
    if (!is.null(ag$days_table) && nrow(ag$days_table) > 0) {
      tbl <- knitr::kable(localise_table(ag$days_table), digits=4, align="c",
                           caption=paste(L("Measurement days —", "Jornadas de medición —"), ag$name)) |>
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"),
                                  full_width=FALSE) |>
        kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white")
      lines <- c(lines, L("**Preliminary assessment — measurement days:**", "**Evaluación preliminar — jornadas de medición:**"), "", tbl, "")
    }

    # Preliminary result
    lines <- c(lines, result_box(ag$result), "")

    # Statistics
    if (!is.null(est)) {
      tbl_est <- data.frame(
        Parameter=c(L("Days (n)", "Jornadas (n)"),L("Distribution", "Distribución"),"MG or MA","DSG or DS",
                    "UT","LSC(95,70)","UR",L("Result", "Resultado")),
        Value=c(est$n, localise_distribution(est$distribution_type),
                round(ifelse(!is.na(est$MG), est$MG, est$MA), 4),
                round(ifelse(!is.na(est$DSG), est$DSG, est$DS), 4),
                round(est$ut,3), round(est$lsc,4), round(est$ur,3),
                if (identical(params$lang, "es") && identical(est$conformity, "NON-CONFORMITY")) "NO CONFORMIDAD" else est$conformity %||% "?"),
        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

      tbl <- knitr::kable(tbl_est, align=c("l","r"),
                           caption=paste(L("Statistical parameters —", "Parámetros estadísticos —"), ag$name)) |>
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"),
                                  full_width=FALSE) |>
        kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white") |>
        kableExtra::row_spec(nrow(tbl_est), bold=TRUE)
      lines <- c(lines, L("**Statistical assessment:**", "**Evaluación estadística:**"), "", tbl, "")
      lines <- c(lines, result_box(if (identical(params$lang, "es") && identical(est$conformity, "NON-CONFORMITY")) "NO CONFORMIDAD" else est$conformity %||% "?"), "")

      # Monitoring interval
      if (!is.na(est$MG) && !is.na(ag$vla)) {
        per1 <- une689_monitoring_interval_opt1(est$MG, vla = ag$vla)
      } else if (!is.na(est$MA) && !is.na(ag$vla)) {
        per1 <- une689_monitoring_interval_opt1(est$MA, vla = ag$vla)
      } else {
        per1 <- NA_character_
      }
      per2 <- if (!is.na(est$lsc) && !is.na(ag$vla)) {
        une689_monitoring_interval_opt2(est$lsc, vla = ag$vla)
      } else NA_character_

      tbl_per <- data.frame(
        Option = c(L("Option 1 (MG or MA vs OEL)", "Opción 1 (MG o MA frente al VLA)"), L("Option 2 (LSC vs OEL)", "Opción 2 (LSC frente al VLA)")),
        Recommendation = c(per1 %||% L("Not available", "No disponible"), per2 %||% L("Not available", "No disponible")),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      tbl <- knitr::kable(tbl_per, align = c("l","l"),
                           caption = paste(L("Monitoring interval —", "Periodicidad de seguimiento —"), ag$name)) |>
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"),
                                  full_width = FALSE) |>
        kableExtra::row_spec(0, background = "#1F4E79", color = "white")
      lines <- c(lines, L("**Monitoring interval (periodic assessment):**", "**Periodicidad de seguimiento:**"), "", tbl, "")
    }

    lines <- c(lines, '</div>', "")
    paste(lines, collapse="\n")
  })

  cat(paste(agent_chunks, collapse="\n"))
}
```

```{r une689_plots, eval=!is.null(params$une689), fig.show='hold'}
# Plots are rendered in a separate chunk (without results='asis')
# so that knitr processes them correctly
if (!is.null(params$une689$preliminary)) {
  for (agent_name in names(params$une689$preliminary)) {
    ag  <- params$une689$preliminary[[agent_name]]
    est <- ag$statistics
    eds <- if (!is.null(est)) est$eds else NULL

    if (!is.null(eds) && length(eds) >= 3 &&
        !is.null(est$distribution_type) &&
        est$distribution_type %in% c("Normal", "Lognormal")) {
      p <- expoquimR:::.une689_parametric_density_plot(
        eds = eds, distribution = est$distribution_type,
        ma = est$MA, ds = est$DS, mg = est$MG, dsg = est$DSG,
        vla = ag$vla, lsc = est$lsc,
        title = paste0(L("ED distribution — ", "Distribución de ED — "), ag$name),
        subtitle = L(
          if (identical(est$distribution_type, "Lognormal")) "Fitted lognormal density" else "Fitted normal density",
          if (identical(est$distribution_type, "Lognormal")) "Densidad log-normal ajustada" else "Densidad normal ajustada"
        ),
        x_label = L("Daily exposure ED (mg/m³)", "Exposición diaria ED (mg/m³)"),
        y_label = L("Density", "Densidad"),
        vla_label = L("OEL", "VLA"),
        lsc_label = L("UCL₉₅,₇₀", "LSC₉₅,₇₀")
      )
      print(p)
      # Graphical examination of the exposure distribution on probability paper.
      if (!est$distribution_type %in% c("Neither", "Ninguna")) {
        pp <- expoquimR::une689_probability_plot(
          ed = eds, distribution = est$distribution_type, vla = ag$vla,
          title = paste0(L("Probability paper — ", "Papel probabilístico — "), ag$name),
          x_label = L("Daily exposure ED (mg/m³)", "Exposición diaria ED (mg/m³)")
        )
        print(pp)
      }
    } else if (!is.null(eds) && length(eds) >= 3) {
      cat(L("\nNo fitted normal or lognormal density: no valid model selected.\n", "\nNo se representa densidad ajustada: no hay modelo normal o log-normal seleccionado.\n"))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r une689_additive, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$une689) && !is.null(params$une689$additive)}
df_ad <- params$une689$additive
if (!is.null(df_ad) && nrow(df_ad) > 0) {
  cat(L("\n### Additive effects\n\n", "\n### Efectos aditivos\n\n"))
  cat(L("Combined exposure index for groups sharing the same target organ (Art. 7, UNE-EN 689). Conformity requires IE_combined ≤ 1.\n\n", "Índice de exposición combinado para grupos con el mismo órgano diana (art. 7, UNE-EN 689). La conformidad requiere IE combinado ≤ 1.\n\n"))

  for (g in sort(unique(df_ad$group[!is.na(df_ad$group)]))) {
    sub <- df_ad[df_ad$group == g, ]
    cat(sprintf(L("**Group %d** — %s\n\n", "**Grupo %d** — %s\n\n"), g, sub$description[1]))
    cat(knitr::kable(localise_table(sub[,c("agent","mean_ie","combined_ie","group_result")]),
                      align=c("l","r","r","l"), row.names=FALSE) |>
          kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","condensed"),
                                    full_width=FALSE) |>
          kableExtra::row_spec(0, background="#1F4E79", color="white"))
    cat("\n")
    cat(result_box(sub$group_result[1]))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
